Both of these compounds are known to interact with the H(+)/Cl(-) exchange transporter 3, indicating a possible pathway of action through the dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase. The evidence suggests that the compound may act through a mechanism involving the regulation of this kinase, which could influence the activity of the H(+)/Cl(-) exchange transporter 3.
